name: Attlestead
source:
What if...

An ordinary guy who is afraid of everything unnatural will face all of this himself, and in the end, even fall in love with one of these...

[From [url=https://eugenko-uwu.itch.io/attlestead]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
如果……

一个对一切超自然事物畏惧不已的普通青年，不得不亲身直面这一切，甚至在最后爱上了其中的某位存在……
